# quotas

Quotas cap how much of each resource a project is allowed to consume.

## GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{project_id}/quota

Operation `project_quota_view`.

Read a project's quota. Returns 404 when the project does not exist, lives in a different tenant, or has no quota set (no record means "unlimited").

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [Quota](schemas.md#quota)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
